_note: Sneakers events. Same format as v0.1 events.json, without everyDays (that is in common.json). skipIf ids are from upgrades/sneakers.json.

events.text: A star athlete wins gold wearing {brand}! The whole world saw the shoes.
A dance video in {brand} sneakers goes viral in {region}.
Resellers in {region} buy every pair of {brand} and sell them for three times the price. The hype is huge!
Fake {brand} sneakers show up at markets in {region}. Real fans get confused.
events.skipText: Fake {brand} sneakers show up in {region}, but your hologram tags expose them in a day.

events.text: Factory delay! Shoe stores in {region} have empty shelves.
events.skipText: Other brands have factory delays. Your own factory keeps {brand} on the shelves.

events.text: {rival} launches {copy}, sneakers that look exactly like {brand}.
events.skipText: {rival} tries to copy the {brand} design, but your patent stops them. For now.

headlines: Man wears one red and one blue sneaker. Fashion experts call it genius.
Sneaker collector buys a second house just for shoes.
Study: new shoes make you run 0% faster but feel 100% faster.
Lost shoe found on the Moon. NASA says it is not theirs.
Shoelace shortage? Experts say: try velcro.
